definition: rays of heat; hot rays (as of the sun).
example_en: The sun's hot rays were scorching the earth.

definition: freedom from being born again.
example_en: Moksha means the state of freedom from being born again.

definition: the act of perusing, examining or scrutinising personally.
example: ಅಧಿಕಾರಿಗಳು ಕಡತಗಳ ತಾರಕಣೆ ಮಾಡಿ ವರದಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The officials personally scrutinized the files and submitted a report.

definition: to give abundantly or generously.
example_en: The grandmother gave sweets generously to her grandchildren.

definition: a skin disease characterised by whitish, reddish or blackish spots.
example_en: A skin disease with spots appeared on his face.

definition: to lever up vehemently.
example_en: The worker vehemently levered up the boulder.

definition: led to formal debate or that has stirred up controversy; disputed; controversial.
example_en: This new law has become a controversial matter.

definition: a title that was being given to rājaputs.
example_en: The title rāval used to be given to Rajputs.

definition: (voice) to become cracked, indistinct.
example_en: His voice became cracked due to the fever.

definition: excessiveness of desire for copulation.
example_en: His excessive lust ruined his very life.

definition: the cardinal number two; 2.

definition: a kind of tent (?).

definition: the state or fact of being; existence.

example_en: The saints said that the existence of this world is not permanent.

definition: absence of flaw, error, etc.; flawlessness; impeccability.
example_en: Everyone appreciated the flawlessness of that report.

definition: to argue in favour of or against (something).
example: ಆ ವಿಷಯದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅವರು ಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಾದಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: They argued about that matter in the meeting.

definition: to make a hole by or as by drilling; to bore a hole.

definition: (smoke) to make something black.

definition: a state of misfortune; adversity.

definition: prosperous condition; prosperity; welfare.

definition: absence of zeal, enthusiasm or inclination for work or physical exertion.
example_en: Because of his laziness he has developed a lack of zeal for work.

definition: urging; inciting; stimulating; provoking.
example: ಗುರುಗಳ ಪ್ರೇರಕ ಮಾತುಗಳು ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಸ್ಫೂರ್ತಿ ನೀಡಿದವು.
example_en: The teacher's inspiring words motivated the students.

definition: the early part of the day; morning.
example_en: The light of early morning spread slowly.

definition: a name; an appellation.
example_en: His name is known to everyone.

definition: excessive lenience.
example_en: Excessive lenience towards children spoils them.

definition: sprinkled; scattered in drops or particles.
example: ನೀರಿನ ಹನಿಗಳು ಉತ್ಸಿಕ್ತವಾಗಿ ನೆಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಿದ್ದವು.
example_en: Drops of water fell sprinkled upon the ground.

definition: a casket, box or chest decorated with pictures or carvings.
example_en: Grandmother had carefully kept the jewels in a decorated casket.

definition: a person who contracts to supply certain materials or do certain work for a stipulated sum; a contractor.
example_en: They appointed a contractor for the building construction.

definition: a right or privilege one is entitled by birth.
example_en: Education is every child's birthright.

definition: to leave out, aside or behind; to abandon; to quit.
example_en: He abandoned the old custom.

definition: absence of a) a road, path; b) means, agency; (alternative) option.
example: ಕಾಡಿನ ನಡುವೆ ಅಮಾರ್ಗದಿಂದ ಅವರು ದಾರಿ ತಪ್ಪಿದರು.
example_en: In the middle of the forest, they lost their way for want of a path.

definition: an accepting or being accepted; an acceptance; a consent; an approval.
example: ಆಕೆ ಅವನ ಕ್ಷಮಾಪಣೆಗೆ ಸಂತೋಷದಿಂದ ಅಪ್ಪುಗೆ ನೀಡಿದಳು.
example_en: She happily gave her acceptance to his apology.

definition: to make a creaking, grating or squeaking sound, as rusted hinges.
example_en: The old door was creaking when it opened.

definition: a disease of the nose; inflammation of the schneiderian membrane.
example_en: Because of the nasal disease, his nose became red and swollen.

definition: a knob - a) a rounded lump or protuberance; b) a ball-like handle of a door, drawer, etc.; c) a similar device used in controlling the operation of equipments as a radio, TV receiver, etc.
example_en: The TV's knob broke.

definition: a woman who is sighing, has sighed or habitually sighs.
example: ಆ ನಿಟ್ಟುಸಿರಿ ತನ್ನ ದುಃಖವನ್ನು ಯಾರೊಡನೆಯೂ ಹಂಚಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That sighing woman did not share her sorrow with anyone.

definition: the act or fact of a thing being suspended as to dangle freely at one end.
example_en: The rope was dangling freely from the tree branch.

definition: the creeper Argyrea malabarica.
example_en: The creeper Argyrea malabarica grows by climbing on trees.

definition: a sound imitating that of a stick breaking; crackling sound.
example: ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಣ ಕೊಂಬೆ ಕಳುಕ್ ಎಂದು ಮುರಿಯಿತು.
example_en: In the forest a dry branch broke with a crack.

definition: any of the two men working together as a pair.
example_en: He was a working partner in that business.

definition: narrowness of the mind; meanness; pettiness.
example: ಅವನ ಖುಲ್ಲ ಸ್ವಭಾವದಿಂದಾಗಿ ಯಾರೂ ಅವನ ಜೊತೆ ಇರಲು ಇಷ್ಟಪಡುತ್ತಿರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Because of his pettiness, no one liked being around him.

definition: the quality, state or feel of being malevolent, malicious; malevolence; maliciousness; wickedness.
example_en: Everyone in the town stayed away because of his wickedness.

definition: want of digestion; indigestion.
example_en: He got indigestion from overeating.

definition: a uncooked arecanut.
example_en: They are drying uncooked arecanuts in the sun.

definition: (mus.) the initial stage in the development of a raga (musical sentiment).
example_en: The singer began singing from the initial stage of the raga.

definition: to put or blend together in a single mass; to mix; to mingle (different things) together.
example_en: She mixed the rice and lentils together.

definition: a tooth.
example_en: The child's first tooth appeared.

definition: a reply given rudely showing deliberate disregard to the other person; an oppugnant, arrogant answer.
example_en: His rude, disrespectful reply upset everyone.

definition: to give emphasis to; to give special force, prominence to; to stress; to emphasise.
example_en: The teacher spoke, giving emphasis to the main point.

definition: the act of marrying (by a man).

definition: the branch of biology that studies plants, their life, structure, growth, classification, etc.; botany.
example_en: Botany is taught at the university.

definition: a professional cook.
example_en: They called a professional cook for the wedding house.

definition: to move forward in a group.
example_en: The children moved forward in a group to the field.

definition: the earth.
example: ವಸುಧೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಜೀವಿಗಳಿಗೂ ಸಮಾನ ಹಕ್ಕಿದೆ.
example_en: All living beings have equal right upon the earth.

definition: the tree Butea bojapatra of Papilionaceae family, the smooth bark of which can easily be peeled off in thin sheets; a birch tree.
example_en: The bark of the birch tree can be peeled off easily.

definition: favourable, congenial relation; friendship.
example: ಆ ಎರಡು ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಬಹಳ ಒಚ್ಚಯ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was great friendship between those two families.

definition: a man employed to guard another; a bodyguard.
example: ಮೆಯ್ಗಾವಲಿಗನು ಶ್ರೀಮಂತನ ಮನೆಯ ಮುಂದೆ ಕಾವಲು ಕಾಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: The bodyguard was keeping watch in front of the rich man's house.

definition: a brave, bold man.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬ ದಿಂಡಿಯ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.

definition: a man who enters into or being rivalry; a contender; a competitor.

example_en: Everyone grew tired of seeing his constant coming and going.

definition: a genuine sexual desire or relation.

definition: attraction - the act, power or an instance of attracting; b) an attracting by arousing interest.

definition: a stupid, clumsy person.

definition: justice, observed as a rule in some poetry, plays, stories, etc., in which good is rewarded and evil punished, in a fitting way; poetical justice.
example_en: Poetical justice was established at the end of that play.

definition: of a different kind.
example: ಇದು ಅನ್ಯಾದೃಶ ಸಂಗತಿ, ಇಂತಹುದನ್ನು ನಾನು ಕೇಳಿಯೇ ಇಲ್ಲ.

definition: the outer side, part or surface; outside.

definition: the work of supervising, superintending; supervision; superintendence.

definition: a kind of bird.
example_en: A lokkiga bird was searching for food in the open field.

definition: either or both of the curved lines, ( ) or the like, used to mark off parenthetical words, etc. or to enclose mathematical or logical symbols; parenthesis; bracket.

definition: to remove or divide into parts with a sharp-edged instrument; to sever; to cut.
example_en: He cut the rope with a knife.

definition: refreshing ease or inactivity after work or exertion; rest.

definition: to give an order; to order.

definition: a woman holding an office, position, etc.; an incumbent.

definition: a piece of furniture to sit on; a seat.

definition: arousing sexual feelings or desires; erotic.

definition: not extending far from end to end; not long or not long enough; short.

definition: that which, as a bird, dives into water (for catching fish); a diver.

definition: a violent and heavy attack; onslaught.

definition: a striking of one thing against another; blow or impact of an ax, whip, etc. a stroke.

definition: a comfortable sleeping-mattress.

definition: a bundle of betel leaves (differing in numbers, being twenty, fifty, hundred etc.).

definition: an interjection used to express grief, compassion, pity; etc.

definition: a sitting on one's knees.

definition: to put forth a flower bud or buds.

definition: to put off to future; to delay; to defer.

definition: a receiving, accepting of gifts (as a right or obligation of a religious brahmaṇa).

definition: the night that is absolutely dark.
example_en: In that pitch-dark night, the path could not be seen.

definition: an arrow with a crescent-head.
example_en: There was a crescent-headed arrow in the quiver.

definition: an acute, infectious disease, characterised by profuse diarrhea, vomiting, cramps, etc.; cholera.

definition: the quality of being intolerant, esp. of otherś opinions, beliefs, etc.; intolerance; bigotry.
example_en: One should not develop intolerance towards others' beliefs.

definition: the sentient principle; the divine intelligence.
example_en: The wise realize the divine intelligence through meditation.

definition: on or to one side; aside.

definition: pushed, driven out or away; warded off; turned aside.

definition: busy and noisy activity; commotion; bustle.

definition: a getting of wealth.

definition: the rain water got by a river (that looks mud-coloured) during monsoon.
example_en: During the rainy season, the fresh monsoon water filled the river.

definition: a bald head.
example_en: That old man's bald head could be seen from far away.

definition: a desire that cannot be resisted easily; an itching desire; the condition of being addicted (to a habit).

definition: to bring or reduce to ruin; to destroy; to spoil; to damage irreparably.

definition: a doubting - a) a wavering of opinion or belief; lack of conviction; uncertainty, b) lack of trust or confidence.

definition: a person having undeveloped or imperfect sexual organs.

definition: (fem.) a specialist in botany; a botanist.

definition: a folded part or layer; a fold.

definition: fury as expressed by one's frightening look.

example_en: Hearing that remark, fury appeared in his frightening look.

definition: the envious or resentful attitude towards another's advantages, merits, wealth, status, etc.; jealousy; envy.

definition: a playing, jumping in joy; merrymaking.

definition: an act of cheating.

definition: the act of condoning, forgiving by overlooking an offence; pardon; forgiveness.

definition: an adult female human being; a woman.

definition: the evergreen plant Thea sinensis (= Camelia thea, = C. sinensis) of Theaceae family.
example_en: They cultivate tea plants on that estate.

definition: a large and hard mass of ice.
example_en: A huge mass of hard ice was seen in the polar region.

definition: a bundle of hay which can be held in one's hand.
example_en: He lifted the handful of hay bundle and fed it to the cattle.

definition: the female crene Ardea sibirica.

definition: a kind of salt used in preparing medicine.
example_en: The doctor used the forest-salt in preparing the medicine.

definition: a region that is not mountainous, but is almost level; the plains; open counry.
example_en: The crops of the open country depend entirely on rain.

definition: gruel or any other cheap food item sponsored by a charitable institution or person.
example_en: They distribute free gruel at the temple.

definition: to bring down; to cause to come down.
example_en: The workers brought the goods down from the truck.

definition: the form of electromagnetic radiation that acts upon the retina of the eye, optic nerve, etc., making sight possible; light.
example_en: The light of the sun illuminates the whole earth.

definition: an incitement given through one side-glance.
example_en: He came forward because of the incitement given through her side-glance.

definition: the plant Ziziphus oenoplia of Rhamnaceae family.
example_en: The suri plant grows at the foot of the hill.

definition: a disease marked by swelling of the glands of the neck.
example_en: The child's neck was swollen with the glandular disease.

definition: having great muscular power; strong.
example_en: He is a strong wrestler.

definition: the fact of living, being settled, as a resident for a considerable period.

definition: to be collected, gathered together.

definition: a horse (Equus caballus).

definition: that which is established with the help of an example or examples.

definition: a kind of rice prepared with green dhal, spices, etc.
example_en: The huggi rice at the wedding feast was very tasty.

definition: (the stake) to be lost.
example_en: His money was lost as the stake in the gambling.

definition: the act or process of extracting or pulling out; extraction; a drawing out.

definition: a man armed with a gun; a gunman.

definition: (Jain.) one of the nine regions above the sixteen heavens.

definition: a degrading or being degraded in moral, social or religious rank, status or condition; disgraceful condition; intermixing of racial or ethnic character considered as derogatory by racists.

definition: to be provoked, angered, incited.

definition: an introductory speech.

definition: utterance of words; speech; conversation.

definition: to cause or force to pay or spend (a sum of money).

definition: a number of Māpiḷḷai community of Malabar area.
example: ಆ ಕಾಕ ಮನೆತನದವರು ಮಲಬಾರ್ ಪ್ರದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಸಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The people of that Kaka community live in the Malabar region.

definition: the agave Agave americana of Agavaceae family.
example_en: They planted the Agave americana plant around the fence.

definition: the condition of somewhat dark; lack of sufficient light; dimness.
example_en: Dimness had filled inside the cave.

definition: to feel sorry or self-reproachful for what one has done or failed to do; to repent.
example_en: She felt repentant for her harsh words.

definition: (math.) an estimating of a missing functional value by taking a weighted average of known functional values at neighbouring points; interpolation.
example: ಗಣಿತಜ್ಞರು ಅಂತರ್ವೇಶನ ವಿಧಾನದಿಂದ ಕಾಣೆಯಾದ ಬೆಲೆಯನ್ನು ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿದರು.
example_en: The mathematician found the missing value by the method of interpolation.

definition: to breathe during sleep with a rough, hoarse noise due to vibration of the soft palate; to snore.
example_en: The tired traveller snored all night.

definition: joined; associated (with).
example: ಈ ವಿಷಯದೊಡನೆ ಸಂಗತವಾದ ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಸಂಗತಿ ಇದೆ.
example_en: There is another matter associated with this topic.

definition: the act of talking uselessly; chattering.
example_en: His chattering at the meeting annoyed everyone.

definition: a man who is temporarily deprived of consciousness.
example: ಬಿಸಿಲಿನಿಂದ ಬಿದ್ದ ಮೂರ್ಛಿತ ಮನುಷ್ಯನನ್ನು ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಗೆ ಕರೆದೊಯ್ದರು.
example_en: They took the man who had fallen unconscious from the heat to the hospital.

definition: not baked (properly); half-baked.
example_en: The bread was half-baked; it still needed to be cooked.

definition: containing, expressing or implying a refusal; that says 'no'.
example_en: His response was completely negative.

definition: the tree Caesalpinia bonduc of Caesalpiniaceae family.
example_en: The Caesalpinia bonduc tree is full of thorns.

definition: swiftness; quickness.
example_en: His swiftness amazed everyone.

definition: non-completion of the process of giving a gift or taking back what is gifted to another.
example_en: Because of the non-completion of the gift, that agreement was not completed.

definition: a metric unit of weight equal to 1,000 grams; a kilogram.
example_en: The shopkeeper weighed and gave one kilogram of rice.

definition: any of the mathematical tables of any number above ten.
example_en: The teacher wrote the multiplication table above ten on the blackboard.
